program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    people = image_patch.find("person")
    if not people: return image_patch
    
    # Sort people by their horizontal and vertical centers
    people.sort(key=lambda p: (p.horizontal_center, p.vertical_center))
    
    # Select the bottom-right quarter of the people
    bottom_right_people = people[len(people) // 4:]
    
    # Find the center of the bottom-right quarter
    total_horizontal_center = sum(person.horizontal_center for person in bottom_right_people)
    total_vertical_center = sum(person.vertical_center for person in bottom_right_people)
    avg_horizontal_center = total_horizontal_center / len(bottom_right_people)
    avg_vertical_center = total_vertical_center / len(bottom_right_people)
    
    # Filter people within a certain radius of the center
    clustered_people = [
        person for person in bottom_right_people 
        if abs(person.horizontal_center - avg_horizontal_center) < 0.2 * (image.width / 2) and
           abs(person.vertical_center - avg_vertical_center) < 0.2 * (image.height / 2)
    ]
    
    return clustered_people[0] if clustered_people else image_patch
